item.description: ## Fixed - A window that can't get narrower, like WhatsApp, no longer pushes its neighbour off the screen. When two windows share a small screen half and half and one of them needs more room, the other one gives up the difference, so both stay fully visible and clicking between them no longer scrolls the strip. Before, the neighbour next to a second monitor could disappear completely.

## Improved - Moves in the Butterfly theme are smoother. The strip map faded in as a separate window at the start of a move, which could make the screen wait for a moment. Now it fades in without that wait. - Butterfly is ready right away after you unlock your Mac or wake the screens. It looks for your windows once instead of several times, and an app that is still waking up no longer holds it up. - Opening a new app while the strip is moving no longer makes the move stutter. - Overview opens without a hitch. App icons and window labels are ready before you open it. - In the Strafe motion the glass appears faster when the strip starts moving.
## Fixed - Windows keep their order on the strip after you come back to a locked Mac. Before, waking the screens before unlocking could take some windows off the strip, and they came back in different places.

## Improved - Several swipes in a row are smoother. After each swipe Butterfly brought the next app forward on the same thread that draws the motion, so the next swipe could stutter. - The strip map no longer makes a move stutter when a window crosses the edge of the screen. - Opening or closing a window, or starting an app, while the strip is moving no longer interrupts the move. The strip picks up the change as soon as it stops.
## Fixed - A window you bring back from the Dock now appears right where it stays. Before, it showed up at its old place for a moment and then moved. - A window that goes full screen on a second display keeps its place on the strip. Before, it could come back as a new window at half the width of the screen.
